facts.text: The scripts control FluentControl instruments programmatically for deck layouts and liquid transfer operations
The client takes a base URL and authenticates with a bearer API key or HTTP basic credentials
get_instrument_status reads GET /api/v1/status and get_deck_layout reads GET /api/v1/deck/layout
post_transfer_session posts the transfers to /api/v1/transfers/session with a generated session_id and status pending
cancel_transfer_session posts to /api/v1/transfers/session/{session_id}/cancel and takes the session id
A transfer finishes with status completed, failed or cancelled
Source and destination are position IDs, liquid class and tip type are names, and the volume is in microliters
Aspiration and dispense speeds are in microliters per second, the air gap and mix volume in microliters, and the retract distance in millimetres
